title: requireTaskCompletion
responsibility: Applies the committed loop or registered task contract before an agent may report a successful finish.

inputs.name: requireTaskCompletion.root
inputs.description: Project filesystem root used to read committed source, loop metadata or verification evidence.

inputs.name: requireTaskCompletion.agent
inputs.description: Registered agent statement, including its declared task, loop and required unit identities.

outputs.name: requireTaskCompletion
outputs.description: Resolves for an undeclared task or a passed declared audit; an unsupported success claim rejects.
